Mid-century European editorial illustration, painterly graphic novel aesthetic, subtle ligne claire contours, simplified geometric shapes and flat color blocking combined with richly textured gouache, dry-brush marks and screenprint grain, matte finish. Moderately luminous exposure with clearly readable midtones and visible architectural details; deep blue shadows without crushed blacks.
